title: Development and validation of a machine-learning model for predicting prognosis in critically ill patients undergoing major surgery
summary: XGBoost models predict 28-day and hospital mortality in critically ill major-surgery patients; a compact 10-feature model was externally validated.
ai_technology: XGBoost models use early ICU data to predict 28-day and hospital mortality in critically ill patients after major surgery.

evidence.tested: XGBoost models predict 28-day and hospital mortality in critically ill major-surgery patients; a compact 10-feature model was externally validated. Full Methods/Results in NCBI PMC BioC; MIMIC-IV development and university-hospital external validation reviewed.
